The lessor may find some benefits to leasing an asset rather than selling it. One advantage is that the residual value is retained if title never passes to the lessee. When the lease term is complete, the lessor still owns the asset. The lessor may lease it again or sell the property for an immediate gain. Another advantage to the lessor is the ongoing business relationship with the lessee. Often, the lessee will lease or buy more assets from the same dealer/lessor. Another advantage is increased sales. Leasing is a way to offer special financing to increase sales.
